title: Select the cutover method for the orders database
summary: Three cutover methods are possible. The plan recommends CDC replication and then a 15-minute switch, because it gives the shortest downtime and a path back to MySQL.

blocks.title: The problem
blocks.html:
At one moment, the shop stops its writes to MySQL and starts its writes to PostgreSQL. The method of this switch sets three things:

  • the downtime of the shop
  • the extra engineering work
  • the path back if the switch fails

blocks.title: What we found
blocks.html:
• [TESTED] The bulk copy of the 10% staging sample took 33 minutes. The index build took 11 minutes. [src: report.md]
  • [INFERRED] At full size, the copy takes about 5 h 30 min and the index build about 1 h 50 min. [src: report.md]
  • [TESTED] At 600 writes/s, the CDC lag stayed between 1 and 3 s. [src: report.md]
  • [READ] On a typical Sunday, about 22,000 orders arrive between 02:00 and 10:20. [src: report.md]

figures.caption: The three methods on one time line, in hours from the start of the copy. The shop is closed only in the vermilion parts. The times come from the 10% staging sample, scaled to full size (INFERRED).

options.label: Big-bang copy in one long downtime window
options.detail_html: Downtime: about 8 h 20 min. Effort: 3 days less (no forward CDC). Risk: high. A failed step makes the window longer. The shop loses about 22,000 Sunday orders. The rollback path (F6) is still necessary after the shop opens.

options.label: CDC replication, then a 15-minute switch
options.detail_html: Downtime: about 15 minutes (10 min write freeze, 5 min switch). Effort: 3 days for CDC setup, in the estimate (F7). Risk: low to medium. A CDC mapping error can copy wrong values. Row counts and checksums find them before the switch.

options.label: Dual writes from the order service
options.detail_html: Downtime: none planned. Effort: 15–20 more engineer-days ($12,000–$16,000). Risk: high. After a partial failure, the two databases drift. A reconciliation job must find and fix each difference.

recommendation_html: Option b. The downtime stays at about 15 minutes. The CDC tool also gives the reverse path for the rollback (D3). Its 3 days of work are already in the cost estimate (F7).
